item.title: SCVTV's Community Corner Season 6, Episode 29 - SCVTV.com
item.description: In this episode of SCVTV’s Community Corner, co-hosts Carrie Lujan and Dave Caldwell kick things off with a recap of recent (and soggy) community events including Bridge to Home's Turkey Trot and Light Up Main Street. They also give us a sneak preview of Santa Clarita Symphony Orchestra's family-friendly concert, "Sounds of the Season."
